courses.title: Programming Foundations: Algorithms
courses.why: Searching, sorting, recursion, common data structures and Big-O by Joe Marini; a quick refresher before the pattern work, set up in GitHub Codespaces.

courses.title: Data Structures in JavaScript: Trees and Graphs
courses.why: Trees, BSTs and graphs in JavaScript with DFS/BFS and classic problems (islands, clone graph, course schedule), the hardest common interview area.

portals.name: LeetCode: Top Interview 150
portals.what: 150 classic interview problems grouped by topic; the standard list companies draw from.

portals.name: NeetCode practice
portals.what: The NeetCode 150 roadmap by pattern, with a free video explanation for each problem.

portals.name: HackerRank Interview Preparation Kit
portals.what: Problems grouped by topic in the same editor HackerRank online assessments use, good practice for timed tests.

portals.name: Grind 75 (Tech Interview Handbook)
portals.what: A week-by-week plan of the 75 highest-value problems that adapts to the hours you have.

portals.name: Codewars
portals.what: Short ranked kata in TypeScript and Python for daily warm-ups.

assessments.name: Problem Solving (Basic) certification
assessments.format: 1 hr 30 min online test, 2 coding questions on arrays and strings
assessments.credential: HackerRank certificate with a shareable URL
assessments.why: The quickest problem-solving credential and a warm-up for the Intermediate test.

assessments.name: Problem Solving (Intermediate) certification
assessments.format: 1 hr 30 min online test, 2 coding questions on data structures (hash maps, stacks, queues)
assessments.credential: HackerRank certificate with a shareable URL
assessments.why: The level that matters for senior roles; many online assessments use the same format.

assessments.name: Software Engineer certification
assessments.format: 1 hr 15 min online test, 3 questions covering problem solving, SQL and REST API
assessments.credential: HackerRank role certificate with a shareable URL
assessments.why: A role certificate that combines algorithms with practical backend skills; sits well next to your Frontend Developer (React) certificate.
